recipe.build:
sed -i -e '/maven.pkg.github.com/d' libxposed/api/api/build.gradle.kts libxposed/service/service/build.gradle.kts libxposed/service/interface/build.gradle.kts
pushd libxposed/api
../../gradlew publishToMavenLocal
popd
pushd libxposed/service
../../gradlew publishToMavenLocal
popd
./gradlew assembleRelease
OUT=app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk
git clone -b v0.2.7 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
reproducible-apk-tools/inplace-fix.py --internal --page-size 4 fix-newlines "$OUT" 'META-INF/services/*'
mv "$OUT" /outputs/unsigned.apk
